opportunities.name: Research paper lookup and citation note
opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced search for a topic restricted to a specific year, open a result, look up the paper on Semantic Scholar for citation count, and save a summary note.
steps: Tick the title/abstract checkbox and choose specific year, enter YYYY
Click Search and open the top result
Search the paper title on Semantic Scholar and open it
Add note '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <n> citations' in the notes app

opportunities.name: Case law lookup with statute and note
opportunities.description: Search a case name on CourtListener, open the case, look up the related US Code section on Cornell LII, and save a note with citation, decision date and statute.
steps: Search the case name on CourtListener and open the result
Read the citation and decision date
Search the statute on Cornell LII and open the section
Add a note '<case>: <cite>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<title>)' in the notes app
